After Library D was reassigned from SAMPLER to FAVORITES, the familiar entry to microphone recording, file import, sample editing, and blank-kit creation effectively disappeared. PLAY D now opens SOUND hub, whose A/B/C actions expose Library (synth/drum editing), Sampler (mic/import/edit/save), and New Kit. Main menu now initially selects SOUND. Existing authoring engines and persistence were intact; this repair restores reachability without altering them.

transitions.resulting_value:
- Samples play full length; Save As crops to trim: SampleVoice.noteOn passed duration len/rate to src.start; Web Audio duration is in buffer seconds (not scaled by playbackRate), so pitched-up samples were truncated. Now start(t,start,len); added playSeconds(midi)=trimSec/rate. One-shot pad timer uses playSeconds (tune-aware) with no 8s cap; source ends naturally, timer only clears held/LED state. Save As (asNew) crops audio via sliceBuffer to trim, resets trim 0..1, refreshes draft peaks/duration; in-place SAVE keeps full audio + trim points. Keys remain gate for samples (user choice).
- Sample SAVE screen: rename, save as, trim: Sample Edit B opens SAVE SAMPLE. D SAVE persists trim/tune/eq/fx in place. B RENAME names (and saves if already in library). C SAVE AS creates a new user sample copy.
- HOLD loops sample pads/keys: With HOLD on, sample pads/keys loop the trimmed region until latched off (second press). Oneshot auto-stop timer disabled while HOLD is active.
- SOUND area: Top-level SOUND: Sound Library/Detail/Edit; Sampler Home -> Mic Record or Import File -> Sample Edit (trim/tools/tune/playback/EQ) -> Save Sample; Pad Assign.
- Screen 12: Sampler Home: Screen 12: Sampler Home.

UI (from mockup): SAMPLER home. Options: Record from onboard mic (selected), Import from file system, Open user sample. Note: new recordings/imports enter same sample editor. M1/M2 preview tone/FX, M3 volume. Soft keys A MIC, B FILE, C OPEN, D BACK.

WHAT IT DOES: No audio changes until a source is recorded/imported. Existing project playback may continue behind the sampler unless the user stops it.
SAVE/STATE: New recordings/imports are staged until the user reaches Save Sample.
NOTES: Microphone and imported sources enter the same editor, so the manipulation workflow is consistent. 17 CASSIO / V1 COMPLETE OPERATING MANUAL
GET: THERE           MENU Hold    ->->SOUND MENU    SOUND to-> Sampler. open the Sound Library, then press D = SAMPLER.
